A hash table of size 9 uses open addressing with linear probing (hash function `h(k) = k mod 9`). Keys are inserted in the following order: `[18, 27, 36, 45, 9]`.
At which slot index in the table will key `9` be placed?
explanation: Key 9 has initial hash 9 % 9 = 0. Due to prior collisions, it requires 5 probe(s) and lands in slot 4.
